before: In suggesting mode, tab stop changes and content control values from the editor applied without a revision: the paragraph dialog rewrote w:tabs, and drop-down, combo box, date, checkbox, and text control values replaced the control content.
after: Tab stops write a w:pPrChange that holds the previous w:pPr. A control value strikes the previous content in a w:del and inserts the new value in a w:ins inside w:sdtContent, and moves w:sdtPr untracked. Accepting or rejecting a revision sets w14:checked to the checkbox glyph that the decision leaves visible.
reason: The replicated results are existing w:pPrChange, w:del, w:ins, and w14:checked structures that released participants already read, and the value write keeps the node identities of w:sdtPr. No stored field, operation kind, or identity rule changes. A released participant that rejects a checkbox suggestion leaves w14:checked unchanged, and its result still replicates to every participant.
